label: GO after a rewarded rare a2->S1 transition, agent still leaning a2 (first ~70 trials)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), and almost only when the previous trial was a2 that went rarely to S1 and was rewarded (prev_reward=1, prev_common=0, prev_action=2: 87% of activation mass). This is the model-based switch case, but the feature fires when the policy still prefers a2 (choice logit < -2; most mass sits in the moderately negative band -8.9..-4.4, with value 7.5-7.7). It is silent after trial ~70 in the episode, which suggests drift over the episode. The base condition alone has F1 0.55; adding ep_trial<70 and choice<-2 gives dev P 0.89, R 0.68, F1 0.77, mass recall 0.81. Missed activations are weak (mostly <0.3 of max): GO steps after a1->S1 common rewarded trials, and the first GO of a window. False positives without the choice condition are mostly GO steps after rare-rewarded trials where the agent leans strongly toward switching or strongly toward a2. Never fires when prev_reward=0 or at D1/D2. Uses only observed variables plus the agent own policy logit.
